name: Channels Finance cCLP_BTCB_BUSD donated-balance exchange-rate manipulation

classification.summary: The cCLP_BTCB_BUSD market derives its accounting from the spot underlying balance of the market contract, so an unpermissioned token donation moves its exchange rate. In the anchor transaction the attacker sent 53,410,306,284,612 wei of the PancakeSwap BTCB/BUSD LP token to the market and called the permissionless gulp(), which booked balanceOf(this) minus the MasterChef stake, 26,704,653,141,956 wei, into totalReserves; exchangeRateStored collapsed from 1,019,546,530,792,148,236,798,388 to 38,177,206,864,348,614,462, every cCLP collateral position became liquidatable, and the attacker liquidated the two remaining borrowers, seized all 26,193,658 cCLP and redeemed 26,193,656 of them, leaving totalSupply at 2 wei. In the follow-up transaction the same defect ran the other way: accrueInterest() stakes idle underlying into MasterChef, so a 2,026.818338424751118747 LP donation became market cash and the attacker's 2 wei of cCLP were revalued at 2,026.83 LP of collateral, which he used to borrow the entire cash of seven Channels markets.

loss.notes: Gross depletion is the seven borrow legs of the follow-up transaction 0x93372ce9c86a25f1477b0c3068e745b5b829d5b58025bb1ab234230d3473b776, taken from the Borrow events and the matching underlying Transfer logs out of cWBNB 0x860df3e99f6223d695ab51b2fb9eaa92fa903e8d, cBUSD 0xca797539f004c0f9c206678338f820ac38466d4b, cUSDT 0xba5b37100538cde248aaa4c92fb330fcf91f557c, cUSDC 0x33e68c922d19d74ce845546a5c12a66ea31385c4, cDAI 0x7d247295a6938587c581f5bb8cbd98a72388e530, cETH 0x11797d61fd4bff9728113601782d4444503093d7 and cBTC 0x7140a671da66c0bd411e3fc3b15c51c36dbb5ca3; each borrow drew that market's entire getCash() and none was repaid. Attacker-supplied inputs are excluded: the PancakeSwap V3 flash loans of 11.9 BTCB and 500,000 BUSD, the 2,026.818338424751118747 LP minted from them and donated to the cCLP market and later redeemed back out, the 2 CAKE seeded before the campaign, and the 53,410,306,284,612 wei LP donated in the anchor transaction. The eighth component is the cCLP market's own collateral pool at the moment of the anchor transaction, 26,705,653,142,656 wei of Cake-LP BTCB/BUSD seized from the two remaining borrowers and redeemed; at roughly 490 USD per LP token this is about 0.013 USD, so it is carried at zero rather than given a spurious price, and it does not affect the total. Gas and the PancakeSwap flash-loan fees are not deducted.

lastCodeChange.description: The CErc20Delegator 0x93790c641d029d1cbd779d87b88f67704b6a8f4c and its delegate 0xbeba905188a00b8c2fa2789e2550a3a3144b1c8f were both created by deployer contract 0x588dd6012954606f4439ef490cc1f66800239e0d in this transaction, which emitted the market's only NewImplementation event (logIndex 228, old 0x0, new 0xbeba9051...). The delegate pointer in storage slot 18 and the delegate runtime were unchanged from that block through block 34805971.

limitations: Neither the delegator nor the delegate is source-verified on BscScan; the failure mechanism was reconstructed from the call trace, the transaction state diff and Compound-fork storage-layout inference rather than from published source.

sources.note: onchain review: victim 0x93790c641d029d1cbd779d87b88f67704b6a8f4c created 2021-12-16T10:01:37Z, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x20395d8e8a11cfd2541b942afdb810b7dcc64681; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).

deployment-basis recheck: Compound-fork CErc20Delegator whose logic pointer is storage slot 18, not the EIP-1967 slot. The victim DELEGATECALLs 0xbeba905188a00b8c2fa2789e2550a3a3144b1c8f for every selector in the attack (accrueInterest, exchangeRateStored, redeem, ...), which is the value of slot 18; binary-searching that slot over [13522248, 34805972] shows it unchanged from creation to the incident, and the delegator runtime is byte-identical at both blocks. Deployment is the correct basis; 744.1 days.

Anchor: walked every transaction of EOA 0x20395d8e8a11cfd2541b942afdb810b7dcc64681 on BSC from nonce 0. Nonces 0-2 deploy helper contracts (the attack contract 0x07e536f23a197f6fb76f42ad01ac2bcdc3bf738e at nonce 2), nonces 3-15 are swaps, a PancakeRouter addLiquidity and four plain ERC20 transfers into the attack contract, and none of them calls a Channels contract. Nonce 16, 0x711cc4ce... at 34805972:63, is the first transaction that executes Channels code and is the anchor; nonce 17, 0x93372ce9..., at 34806206:2 is the only other campaign transaction that touches Channels. Root cause reproduced from the callTracer trace and the prestateTracer diff of the anchor. Storage of 0x93790c641d029d1cbd779d87b88f67704b6a8f4c moved accrualBlockNumber 33591403 -> 34805972, totalReserves 0 -> 26704653141956, totalSupply 26193658 -> 2, and slot 0x13 0 -> 53410306284612, the exact amount of Cake-LP BTCB/BUSD 0xf45cd219aef8618a92baa7ad848364a158a24f33 the attacker transferred in at frame 0.5. Reading the market at the block boundaries: at 34805971 getCash 26705653142656, totalBorrows 0, totalReserves 0, totalSupply 26193658, exchangeRateStored 1019546530792148236798388, LP balance of the market 0; at 34805972 getCash 26704653142033, totalReserves 26704653141956, totalSupply 2, exchangeRateStored 38500000000000000000, LP balance 53410306284612. balanceOf(market) 53410306284612 minus the MasterChef stake 26705653142656 equals 26704653141956, exactly the new totalReserves, so the permissionless gulp() booked the donation as reserves and cut the exchange rate by a factor of about 26,700; the two remaining borrowers (accountTokens 25571355 and 622303) were then liquidated through cWBNB and cFIL for dust repayments of 1370983453 wei BTCB and 1818928391 wei FIL, all 26193658 cCLP were seized and 26193656 redeemed. In the follow-up transaction accrueInterest() staked the 2026.818338424751118747 LP donation into MasterChef so getCash became 2026833267012053380793 against totalSupply 2, and the seven borrow legs listed in loss.notes drained every market. The recorded legacy summary had the direction of the anchor transaction backwards and named no mechanism; it is replaced. Target: the anchor trace shows 0x93790c641d029d1cbd779d87b88f67704b6a8f4c called at frames 0.2, 0.6, 0.11, 0.12, 0.13 and 0.14 and DELEGATECALLing 0xbeba905188a00b8c2fa2789e2550a3a3144b1c8f for accrueInterest (0xa6afed95), gulp (0x94909e62), balanceOf and redeem (0xdb006a75); slot 18 holds 0x...beba9051 at both 13522248 and 34805971. The delegate runtime is 22,928 bytes and hashes to 0x970319aadc5924ab7de85ef5c1cb5b86ec527019d2777160a84b62988790ccee at both 13522248 and 34805971. Both contracts were created by deployer 0x588dd6012954606f4439ef490cc1f66800239e0d, itself created top-level by 0x4348bf5f11b89daf602aae958d5826a80bb603ee, in transaction 0xaaf69135... at 13522248:83, timestamp 1639648897; eth_getLogs over [13522248, 34805972] returns exactly one NewImplementation(address,address) event on the market, logIndex 228 of that same creation transaction, and no Upgraded(address) event, so the deployment basis holds and codeAgeSeconds is 1703938731 - 1639648897 = 64289834 (744.1 days). Loss: the seven Borrow events and their underlying Transfer logs in the follow-up transaction were summed exactly and priced at the anchor timestamp with DefiLlama, giving 321340.22 USD.

limitations: The Channels market contracts are not source-verified on BscScan; the failure mechanism, the storage layout and the gulp() reserve accounting were reconstructed from call traces, transaction state diffs and block-boundary state reads.
